root_cause: The modal overlay element has the close trigger attribute (data-micromodal-close) and is an ancestor of the checkbox. When the checkbox receives a Space keypress, the browser synthesizes a click event that bubbles up to the overlay, causing the modal to close.
repair_strategy: Restructure the modal HTML so the overlay is a sibling of the container rather than its parent, and adjust CSS to keep the overlay as a full-screen backdrop and the container centered. This prevents clicks inside the container from bubbling to the overlay.
